propositions: A new helper script must enumerate live origin heads and tags at runtime, collapse annotated-tag peeled refs, and record exact direct and peeled OIDs for each ref without hardcoded counts.
The script must generate a JSON manifest and off-repository bundle containing the old ticket tip and requested pin refs, verifying the bundle and restoring it to confirm exact OID reproduction.

The script must refuse execution on partial/promisor clones, reject output paths inside Git directories or registered worktrees, prevent artifact overwriting, and perform no remote mutations (push or delete).

The script must classify each enumerated commit ref with exactly one old-tip relationship (same, ancestor, descendant, diverged, merge-base, unrelated, or non-commit) and record pre- and post-execution remote state byte-identical.
Failure recovery must remove only the current invocation's namespace under refs/reclaim-backup/ and leave no incomplete artifacts, while abnormal termination requires fresh-clone retry.

A6-0d performs a rehearsal run against a real unfiltered clone, records artifact paths and SHA-256 checksums, and requires A6-1 to recreate the final bundle if the quiet-window old tip differs from the observed value.
